description.en: The three degrees of price discrimination by what the seller knows: third degree (one MR = MC per market), second degree (packages that make each type pick its own), first degree and two-part tariffs, with the profits side by side.
description.zh: 按卖方知道多少分出的三级价格歧视：三级（每个市场 MR = MC）、二级（让每类人自己挑套餐）、一级与两部定价，利润并排比较。

description.en: Charging the high type its full value, which makes it switch to the small package
description.zh: 向高需求类型收取全部价值，结果它改买小套餐

description.en: Giving the low type the quantity where its demand meets MC, ignoring the rent paid to the high type
description.zh: 给低需求类型 MC 处的有效数量，忽略了要付给高类型的信息租金

rows.en: Package 1: 18 units for \$254. Package 2: 2 units for \$30. Profit $164$ (one buyer of each type).
rows.zh: 套餐 1：18 个，254 美元。套餐 2：2 个，30 美元。利润 $164$（每类各一位买家）。

items.en: What makes price discrimination possible, and its three degrees.
items.zh: 价格歧视要什么条件，以及它的三个等级。

items.en: Third degree: treat each group as its own monopoly market.
items.zh: 三级：把每一组当成一个单独的垄断市场。

items.en: Second degree: a menu that makes each type choose its own package; the high type keeps an information rent.
items.zh: 二级：一份菜单，让每类人自己挑自己的套餐；高类型留下信息租金。

items.en: The value of a package is the area under a buyer's demand.
items.zh: 一个套餐的价值是买家需求曲线下的面积。

title.en: Three degrees, one question: what does the seller know?
title.zh: 三个等级，一个问题：卖方知道多少？

text.en: Price discrimination needs three things: market power (a price above $MC$ to play with), a way to **sort** buyers (by group, or by letting them choose), and **no resale** (otherwise those who pay little resell to those who pay a lot).
text.zh: 价格歧视要三个条件：市场势力（价格高于 $MC$，才有空间）、能把买家**分开**（按组别，或者让他们自己选）、**不能转卖**（否则低价买的人会转卖给高价买的人）。

rows.en: that two kinds exist, not who is who
rows.zh: 知道有两类人，但分不清谁是谁

rows.en: offers a menu and lets buyers pick
rows.zh: 给出菜单，让买家自己挑

rows.en: charges each the most it would pay
rows.zh: 向每个人收他最多愿付的钱

text.en: Second degree beats third here not because the seller knows more, but because it sells **packages** (all-or-nothing deals) rather than a price per unit, which captures most of each buyer's surplus. What stops it reaching 212 is the one thing it does not know: who is who.
text.zh: 这里二级比三级赚得多，不是因为卖方知道得更多，而是因为它卖的是**套餐**（要么全买、要么不买），而不是按单价卖，于是能拿走每个买家大部分的剩余。它到不了 212，就差在它唯一不知道的那件事：谁是谁。

summary.en: Where the uniform price 13 comes from
summary.zh: 统一价 13 是怎么来的

text.en: With one price below 16 both types buy, so add the demands: $Q = (24 - p) + (16 - p) = 40 - 2p$, or $p = 20 - Q/2$. Then $MR = 20 - Q = 6$ gives $Q = 14$, $p = 13$ and profit $(13 - 6) \times 14 = 98$. (Selling only to type 1 at its monopoly price 15 earns $9 \times 9 = 81$: less.)

title.en: Third degree: one MR = MC per market
title.zh: 三级：每个市场各自 MR = MC

text.en: With a constant marginal cost the two markets do not interact, so treat each as its own monopoly: $MR_i = MC$ in each. The result follows the Lerner rule, $\frac{p_i - MC}{p_i} = \frac{1}{|\varepsilon_i|}$: the **less elastic** market gets the **higher** price. Students and pensioners pay less because they are more price-sensitive.
text.zh: 边际成本为常数时两个市场互不影响，把每个都当成一个单独的垄断：各自 $MR_i = MC$。结果符合勒纳法则 $\frac{p_i - MC}{p_i} = \frac{1}{|\varepsilon_i|}$：**弹性越小**的市场价格**越高**。学生和老人票便宜，是因为他们对价格更敏感。

why.en: $dQ_i/dp_i = -1$ in both; evaluate at each market's own price and quantity.
why.zh: 两边 $dQ_i/dp_i = -1$；各自在自己的价格和数量处算。
利润 = 每单位利润 × 数量，再相加。

prompt.en: Total profit: margin times quantity in each market, added.
prompt.zh: 总利润：每个市场的单位利润乘数量，再相加。

title.en: Second degree: packages, and the two constraints that bind
title.zh: 二级：套餐，以及两个起作用的约束

items.en: **What a package is worth.** $q$ units are worth the area under a buyer's demand up to $q$: $V_1(q) = 24q - \tfrac{q^2}{2}$ and $V_2(q) = 16q - \tfrac{q^2}{2}$.
items.zh: **套餐值多少。** $q$ 个单位对买家的价值 = 需求曲线下从 0 到 $q$ 的面积：$V_1(q) = 24q - \tfrac{q^2}{2}$，$V_2(q) = 16q - \tfrac{q^2}{2}$。

items.en: **The low type pays its full value:** $T_2 = V_2(q_2)$, so it is just willing to buy (its **participation constraint** binds).
items.zh: **低需求类型付满它的价值：** $T_2 = V_2(q_2)$，它刚好愿意买（**参与约束** participation constraint 是紧的）。

items.en: **The high type must not prefer package 2.** It values package 2 at $V_1(q_2)$, more than type 2 does by $8q_2$ (its demand is 8 higher at every unit). So package 1 must leave it at least that much: $T_1 = V_1(q_1) - 8q_2$ (its **incentive constraint** binds). That $8q_2$ is the **information rent**: what the seller pays for not knowing who is who.
items.zh: **高需求类型不能更想要套餐 2。** 它对套餐 2 的估值 $V_1(q_2)$ 比类型 2 高 $8q_2$（它的需求每个单位都高 8）。所以套餐 1 至少得给它留这么多：$T_1 = V_1(q_1) - 8q_2$（**激励约束** incentive constraint 是紧的）。这 $8q_2$ 就是**信息租金**（information rent）：卖方为“分不清谁是谁”付的代价。

items.en: **Two rules follow.** No distortion at the top: type 1 gets the efficient amount, where its demand meets $MC$. Shrink the bottom: each extra unit for type 2 brings in its value minus $MC$, but raises the rent by 8, so stop where $16 - q_2 - 6 = 8$.
items.zh: **由此得两条规则。** 顶端不扭曲：类型 1 拿有效数量，即它的需求与 $MC$ 相交处。底端缩量：给类型 2 每多一个单位，赚它的价值减 $MC$，但租金多 8，所以停在 $16 - q_2 - 6 = 8$。

caption.en: Drag the size of package 2. Green $T_2$: what type 2 pays. Gold $R$: the rent type 1 must be left. Right: one more unit in package 2 earns $D_2 - MC$ and costs $D_1 - D_2 = 8$ of rent; the profit is highest where the two lines cross.
caption.zh: 拖动套餐 2 的大小。绿色 $T_2$：类型 2 付的钱。金色 $R$：必须留给类型 1 的租金。右边：套餐 2 再加一个单位，赚 $D_2 - MC$，多付 $D_1 - D_2 = 8$ 的租金；两条线相交处利润最高。

why.en: Profit from both packages, with the binding constraints already in the prices.
why.zh: 两个套餐的利润，价格里已经用上了两个紧约束。

why.en: Shrink the bottom until the gain from one more unit equals the rent it costs.
why.zh: 底端缩量，直到多一个单位的收益等于它多付的租金。

why.en: Type 2 pays all it is worth to it.
why.zh: 类型 2 付满它的价值。
类型 1 留下 16 的租金。

why.en: Revenue minus the cost of the units in each package.
why.zh: 收入减去每个套餐里那些单位的成本。

title.en: Check that each type picks its own package
title.zh: 检查：每类人都选了自己的套餐

items.en: Type 1 values package 2 at $V_1(2) = 46$ and package 1 at $V_1(18) = 270$; type 2 values package 1 at $V_2(16) = 128$ (it would not want more than 16). Indifferent buyers are assumed to take the package meant for them.
items.zh: 类型 1 对套餐 2 估值 $V_1(2) = 46$，对套餐 1 估值 $V_1(18) = 270$；类型 2 对套餐 1 估值 $V_2(16) = 128$（多于 16 个它也不要）。无差异时，默认买家选为他设计的套餐。

items.en: Selling only to type 1 (18 units for 270) would earn $270 - 108 = 162 < 164$: serving both is better, just.
items.zh: 只卖给类型 1（18 个卖 270）赚 $270 - 108 = 162 < 164$：两类都卖更好，但只好一点点。

items.en: Package 1 costs $254/18 \approx 14.1$ per unit, package 2 costs $15$: a quantity discount, which is how second-degree pricing looks in real life.
items.zh: 套餐 1 每单位约 $254/18 \approx 14.1$，套餐 2 每单位 $15$：数量折扣，这就是现实中二级价格歧视的样子。

prompt.en: Suppose the seller charged type 1 its full value, 270, for package 1. What would happen?
prompt.zh: 假设卖方对套餐 1 收类型 1 的全部价值 270。会发生什么？

label.en: Type 1 would switch to package 2 and keep a surplus of 16 there
label.zh: 类型 1 会改买套餐 2，在那里留下 16 的剩余

label.en: Type 1 would still buy package 1: it is worth 270 to it
label.zh: 类型 1 仍会买套餐 1：对它值 270

feedback.en: It would be indifferent about buying package 1 (surplus 0), but package 2 gives it $46 - 30 = 16$. It takes package 2.
feedback.zh: 买套餐 1 剩余为 0，而套餐 2 给它 $46 - 30 = 16$。它会选套餐 2。

feedback.en: Only if type 1 kept buying package 1, which it does not.
feedback.zh: 前提是类型 1 继续买套餐 1，可它不会。

explain.en: That is why package 1 must leave type 1 the rent it could get from package 2: $T_1 = 270 - 16 = 254$.
explain.zh: 这就是为什么套餐 1 必须给类型 1 留下它从套餐 2 能得到的租金：$T_1 = 270 - 16 = 254$。

title.zh: 一级价格歧视与两部定价

items.en: **First degree** (perfect): each buyer pays its full value for every unit. Output is efficient (each buyer gets up to where its demand meets $MC$), there is no deadweight loss, and consumer surplus is zero. Here: $V_1(18) - 108 = 162$ from type 1 and $V_2(10) - 60 = 50$ from type 2, total 212.
items.zh: **一级**（完全）价格歧视：每个买家为每个单位付满价值。产量有效（每个买家都买到需求等于 $MC$ 处），没有无谓损失，消费者剩余为零。本题：类型 1 贡献 $V_1(18) - 108 = 162$，类型 2 贡献 $V_2(10) - 60 = 50$，合计 212。

items.en: **Two-part tariff** (an entry fee plus a price per unit) for identical buyers: set the price per unit at $MC$, so each buys the efficient amount, and take the whole consumer surplus as the fee. With only type 1: price 6, fee $\tfrac12 \times 18 \times 18 = 162$. Gyms, theme parks and phone plans work this way.
items.zh: 对相同买家用**两部定价**（入场费 + 单价）：单价定在 $MC$，每人买有效数量，再用入场费拿走全部消费者剩余。只有类型 1 时：单价 6，入场费 $\tfrac12 \times 18 \times 18 = 162$。健身房、主题公园、手机套餐都是这样。

items.en: With different buyers a two-part tariff faces the same problem as packages: a fee high enough for type 1 drives type 2 away.
items.zh: 买家不同时，两部定价和套餐面临同样的问题：对类型 1 够高的入场费会把类型 2 赶走。

text.en: Traps, and how the question could change
text.zh: 易错点，以及题目可能怎么变

items.en: Giving type 2 its efficient amount, 10 units: that ignores the rent the seller pays type 1 for every unit in package 2.
items.zh: 给类型 2 有效数量 10 个：忽略了套餐 2 里每个单位都要多付给类型 1 的租金。

items.en: In third degree, writing the elasticity at the wrong point, or without its sign.
items.zh: 三级里在错误的点算弹性，或者丢了负号。

items.en: Different numbers of each type ($n_1$ and $n_2$): the bottom rule becomes $16 - q_2 - 6 = 8\,\tfrac{n_1}{n_2}$; when that pushes $q_2$ to 0, serve only type 1.
items.zh: 两类人数不同（$n_1$ 和 $n_2$）：底端规则变成 $16 - q_2 - 6 = 8\,\tfrac{n_1}{n_2}$；如果这使 $q_2$ 变成 0，就只卖给类型 1。

items.en: Increasing marginal cost in third degree: set $MR_1 = MR_2 = MC(Q_1 + Q_2)$ together.
items.zh: 三级里边际成本递增：联立 $MR_1 = MR_2 = MC(Q_1 + Q_2)$。

prompt.en: Demands are $Q_1 = 30 - p_1$ and $Q_2 = 20 - 2p_2$, and $MC = 4$. With third-degree price discrimination, what is the total profit?
prompt.zh: 需求 $Q_1 = 30 - p_1$、$Q_2 = 20 - 2p_2$，$MC = 4$。三级价格歧视下总利润是多少？

hints.en: Write market 2 as inverse demand first: $p_2 = 10 - Q_2/2$.
hints.zh: 先把市场 2 写成反需求：$p_2 = 10 - Q_2/2$。

prompt.en: Type A has demand $20 - q$, type B has $12 - q$, $MC = 2$, one buyer of each. What total price $T_A$ should package A carry?
prompt.zh: 类型 A 需求 $20 - q$，类型 B 需求 $12 - q$，$MC = 2$，每类一位买家。套餐 A 的总价 $T_A$ 应定多少？

explain.en: $q_A = 18$ (where $20 - q = 2$). The gap between the demands is 8, so $12 - q_B - 2 = 8$ gives $q_B = 2$ and $T_B = 24 - 2 = 22$. $V_A(18) = 360 - 162 = 198$, so $T_A = 198 - 8 \times 2 = 182$. Profit $= 146 + 18 = 164$.

hints.en: First $q_A$ (no distortion at the top), then $q_B$ (shrink the bottom), then the prices.
hints.zh: 先定 $q_A$（顶端不扭曲），再定 $q_B$（底端缩量），最后定价格。

prompt.en: Identical buyers each have demand $p = 30 - q$, and $MC = 10$. With the best two-part tariff, what is the entry fee per buyer?
prompt.zh: 买家都一样，每人需求 $p = 30 - q$，$MC = 10$。最优两部定价下，每人的入场费是多少？

explain.en: Price per unit $= MC = 10$, so each buys 20; the fee takes the whole consumer surplus, $\tfrac12 \times 20 \times (30 - 10) = 200$.
explain.zh: 单价 $= MC = 10$，每人买 20；入场费拿走全部消费者剩余：$\tfrac12 \times 20 \times (30 - 10) = 200$。
